plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any given bid from others, bidding your value maximizes your expected profit. If I bid less than my value, I risk losing the auction to someone who bids higher, even if their value is lower than mine. If I bid more than my value, I risk overpaying. Since this is round 1 of 1, there's no history to learn from. Therefore, I will bid my value.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you win if and only if your bid is the highest, and you pay the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values the item more, while bidding more than your value risks winning but paying more than the item is worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my value of $33.

The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any bid from others, bidding your value either wins you a profit (if your value is higher than the second-highest bid) or avoids a loss (if your value is lower than the second-highest bid). Since this is the only round, there's no learning to be done from previous rounds. Therefore, I will bid my exact value.
